content: I have enough distinct enforcement sites. Let me confirm the memo_service.go ListMemos filter site and check GetMemo (single memo fetch) also uses checkMemoReadAccess.

h15.

Enforcement site — path, one per line

Memo read-access gate (`checkMemoReadAccess`, used by GetMemo/comment listing) — server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:39-68
Memo list visibility filter (anonymous/authenticated visitor scoping) — server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:219-225
Comment creation visibility check (before allowing a comment on a memo) — server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:33-43
Attachment access check (linked attachment follows parent memo visibility) — server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:422-455
Memo-attachment listing visibility check — server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:213-224
Reaction listing visibility check — server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:29-41 (and again at :83)
Mention-context access check (who can be notified/see mention) — server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go:56-72
User stats memo-visibility filter — server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go:84-90, 218-220
Notification inbox visibility gate — server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go:309-312
Outbound notification email visibility gate — server/notification/email.go:313-316
Static file/attachment download visibility check (HTTP fileserver, separate from the gRPC attachment API) — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:660-699
RSS feed visibility filter (public-only) — server/router/rss/rss.go:90, 141

These span at least four distinct server surfaces: the gRPC/Connect API v1 layer (memo_service.go, memo_service_comments.go, attachment_service.go, memo_attachment_service.go, reaction_service.go, memo_mention_helpers.go, user_service_stats.go, user_service_notifications.go), the plain-HTTP fileserver (fileserver.go), the RSS feed handler (rss.go), and the outbound notification/email pipeline (email.go) — each re-implementing its own `store.Visibility` check rather than sharing one gate.
